items.q: 店の売上金額は、毎日出納帳に記入しています。
items.qr: Mise no uriage kingaku wa, mainichi suitouchou ni kinyuu shite imasu.
items.en: Every day we write the shop's sales figures in the cash book.
items.hi: दुकान की बिक्री की रक़म हम रोज़ रोकड़ बही (हिसाब-किताब की कॉपी) में लिखते हैं।
items.gu: દુકાનના વેચાણની રકમ અમે રોજ રોકડ મેળ (હિસાબની ચોપડી)માં લખીએ છીએ.
items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.2, PDF 86). Book's notes (paraphrased): 出納帳 = すいとうちょう, an account book. In the 漢字 block, 出 has the reading スイ and 納 the reading トウ only in the word 出納 (money in and out); otherwise 出 is シュツ (出演, 出世) and 納 is ノウ (納税). (added, not in book) Option 4 is the trap: it uses each kanji's everyday reading, which is exactly what reading type 5 on p.3 warns about. 1 and 2 mix kun/on pieces tha

items.q: 失業して、家賃や税金の支払いが滞ってしまった。
items.qr: Shitsugyou shite, yachin ya zeikin no shiharai ga todokootte shimatta.
items.en: After I lost my job, I fell behind on paying my rent and taxes.
items.hi: नौकरी छूटने के बाद मेरा किराया और कर का भुगतान बकाया हो गया।
items.gu: નોકરી ગયા પછી મારું ભાડું અને કરની ચુકવણી બાકી પડી ગઈ.

opts.en: fall behind, be held up (滞る)
go back (to the past / upstream) (遡る)
lean to one side, be biased (偏る)

items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.2, PDF 86). Book's notes (paraphrased): 滞る = とどこおる; on-yomi タイ as in 滞納 (unpaid), 渋滞 (traffic jam). Its 選択肢の言葉 gives the kanji of the other options: 2 遡る, 3 偏る, 4 漂う — all real verbs, but none is written 滞. (added, not in book) All four end in 〜って, so only knowing the kanji helps; 支払いが滞る is the set phrase for late payment (compare 滞納).

items.q: パンをスープに浸して食べた。
items.qr: Pan o suupu ni hitashite tabeta.
items.en: I dipped the bread in the soup and ate it.
items.hi: मैंने ब्रेड को सूप में डुबोकर खाया।
items.gu: મેં બ્રેડને સૂપમાં બોળીને ખાધી.
items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.2, PDF 86). Book's notes (paraphrased): 浸す = ひたす (dip); 浸る = ひたる (be soaked / be immersed, e.g. in joy); on-yomi シン as in 浸水. 選択肢の言葉 (別冊 p.3, PDF 87): 1 吊るす, 2 溶かす, 4 果たす. (added, not in book) 溶かす is the most tempting because soup is involved, but it means "dissolve", and its kanji is 溶, not 浸.

items.q: 出発の時刻になり、見送りに来た友人に別れを告げた。
items.qr: Shuppatsu no jikoku ni nari, miokuri ni kita yuujin ni wakare o tsugeta.
items.en: When it was time to leave, I said goodbye to the friends who had come to see me off.
items.hi: रवाना होने का समय हुआ तो मैंने विदा करने आए दोस्तों से विदाई ली।
items.gu: નીકળવાનો સમય થયો ત્યારે મને વળાવવા આવેલા મિત્રોની મેં વિદાય લીધી.

opts.en: not the reading of 告げた

items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.3, PDF 87). Book's notes (paraphrased): 告げる = つげる (tell, say); on-yomi コク as in 告知, 申告, 予告. 選択肢の言葉: 3 遂げる, 4 焦げる. (added, not in book) The four options differ only in the first kana (す/つ/と/こ + げた). 別れを告げる "bid farewell" is a fixed phrase worth learning whole. 1 is not given a kanji by the 別冊 — treat it as a non-answer.

items.q: 新聞の記事からニュースを抜粋して、レポートの参考にしている。
items.qr: Shinbun no kiji kara nyuusu o bassui shite, repooto no sankou ni shite iru.
items.en: I take extracts of news from newspaper articles and use them as reference for my report.
items.hi: मैं अख़बार के लेखों से ख़बरों के अंश निकालकर उन्हें अपनी रिपोर्ट के संदर्भ के रूप में इस्तेमाल करता/करती हूँ।
items.gu: હું છાપાના લેખોમાંથી સમાચારના અંશ કાઢીને મારા રિપોર્ટ માટે સંદર્ભ તરીકે વાપરું છું.

opts.en: wrong — the small っ is missing
wrong — kun-yomi ぬき mixed with on-yomi
opts.hi: (ग़लत — कुन और ऑन पठन मिला दिए)

items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.3, PDF 87). Book's notes (paraphrased): 抜粋 = ばっすい; 抜 on-yomi バツ (抜群, 選抜, and ばっ in 抜歯 ばっし), kun-yomi ぬける / ぬく / ぬかす; 粋 = スイ (純粋, 無粋, and 粋 on its own = "the best part"). (added, not in book) This is trap type 3 from p.3: バツ + s-sound → ばっ. 1 ignores the 促音; 2 and 4 use the kun-yomi of 抜, which never appears in this two-kanji on-yomi compound.

items.q: あ、それでは上下が逆様ですよ。
items.qr: A, sore de wa jouge ga sakasama desu yo.
items.en: Oh, that way it's upside down.
items.hi: अरे, ऐसे तो यह उलटा (ऊपर-नीचे) है।
items.gu: અરે, આમ તો આ ઊંધું (ઉપર-નીચે) છે.

opts.en: not a word here (ぎゃく without ゛)

opts.hi: (कोई शब्द नहीं — ऑन + कुन मिला दिया)

items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.3, PDF 87). Book's notes (paraphrased): 逆様 = さかさま (upside down). 逆 has on-yomi ギャク (逆転, 逆流) and kun-yomi さか (逆さ, 逆立ち) / さからう; 様 has ヨウ (様式, 多様) and さま (お客様, 様変わり). (added, not in book) 逆様 uses both kun-yomi: さか + さま. Option 2 ぎゃくさま is the most tempting because each half is a real reading — but they come from different reading systems. 逆さ (さかさ) means the same thing.

items.q: 教会での結婚式の後、ホテルで披露宴が行われた。
items.qr: Kyoukai de no kekkonshiki no ato, hoteru de hirouen ga okonawareta.
items.en: After the wedding ceremony at the church, a reception was held at a hotel.
items.hi: चर्च में शादी की रस्म के बाद होटल में रिसेप्शन (विवाह-भोज) हुआ।
items.gu: ચર્ચમાં લગ્નવિધિ પછી હોટલમાં રિસેપ્શન (લગ્ન-ભોજન) યોજાયું.

opts.en: wrong — extra long vowel in ひ
wrong — 露 needs the long ろう here

items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.4, PDF 88). Book's notes (paraphrased): 披露宴 = ひろうえん. 披 = ヒ (披露); 露 has three readings — ロ (露骨, 露出, 暴露 ばくろ), ロウ (only in 披露) and つゆ (dew); 宴 = エン (宴会, 祝宴). (added, not in book) A pure trap-type-1 question (long vs short vowel): 披 is short ひ, 露 is long ろう. Options 3 and 4 use the ロ reading of 露 from 露骨 / 暴露, which is wrong inside 披露.

items.q: 顔色が冴えないね。どうしたの。
items.qr: Kaoiro ga saenai ne. Dou shita no.
items.en: You don't look well. What's wrong?
items.hi: तुम्हारा चेहरा उतरा हुआ लग रहा है। क्या हुआ?
items.gu: તારો ચહેરો ઊતરેલો લાગે છે. શું થયું?

opts.en: never ends (絶える) / can't bear (堪える・耐える)
opts.hi: ख़त्म नहीं होता / सहन नहीं होता
opts.gu: ખતમ થતું નથી / સહન થતું નથી

items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.4, PDF 88). Book's notes (paraphrased): 冴える = さえる (be bright, clear, healthy-looking); 冴えない = dull, gloomy, not well; 例 冴えた月の光 (clear moonlight). 選択肢の言葉: 1 冷えない (冷える), 2 消えない (消える), 4 絶えない (絶える) / 堪えない (堪える) / 耐えない (耐える). (added, not in book) 冴 has 冫 (ice) like 冷 — that makes ひえない tempting — but 冷 is a different kanji. 顔色が冴えない is a set phrase for "look pale / off-colour".

items.q: 中途半端な気持ちでは、どんな仕事も務まらない。
items.qr: Chuutohanpa na kimochi de wa, donna shigoto mo tsutomaranai.
items.en: With a half-hearted attitude you can't do any job properly.
items.hi: आधे-अधूरे मन से कोई भी काम ठीक से नहीं निभाया जा सकता।
items.gu: અધૂરા મનથી કોઈ પણ કામ બરાબર નિભાવી શકાતું નથી.

opts.en: wrong — kun-yomi はし used for 端
opts.hi: (ग़लत — 端 का कुन पठन はし)

opts.en: wrong — なか for 中 and a voiced ど
opts.hi: (ग़लत — 中 = なか और ど)
opts.gu: (ખોટું — 中 = なか અને ど)

opts.en: wrong — kun-yomi なか for 中

items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.4, PDF 88). Book's notes (paraphrased): 中途半端 = ちゅうとはんぱ. 中 = チュウ (中継, 中断), ジュウ (一日中, 年中), なか (中程); 途 = ト (途上, 前途); 半 = ハン (半減), パン (折半), なか(ば); 端 = タン (端末, 極端), はし／はじ, は／ぱ (半端), はた (edge). (added, not in book) Two traps: 中 here is on-yomi ちゅう (it is a four-kanji on-yomi compound), and 端 after ん becomes ぱ (trap type 4, like 突風 とっぷう). はし is the kun-yomi "edge" and never appears in 半端.

items.q: そんなくだらない議論に貴重な時間を費やすのはやめよう。
items.qr: Sonna kudaranai giron ni kichou na jikan o tsuiyasu no wa yameyou.
items.en: Let's stop spending precious time on such a pointless argument.
items.hi: ऐसी बेकार बहस में क़ीमती समय गँवाना बंद करें।
items.gu: આવી નકામી ચર્ચામાં કીમતી સમય વેડફવાનું બંધ કરીએ.
items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.5, PDF 89). Book's notes (paraphrased): 費やす = ついやす; on-yomi ヒ／ピ as in 出費 (しゅっぴ), 交通費, 学費. 選択肢の言葉: 2 冷やす, 3 耕す, 4 燃やす. (added, not in book) ひやす is the trap because 費's on-yomi is ヒ — but the verb 費やす uses the kun-yomi つい. All four options end in 〜やす / 〜す, so the kanji itself must be known.

items.q: 彼は辛い仕事を忍耐強く続けている。
items.qr: Kare wa tsurai shigoto o nintai-zuyoku tsuzukete iru.
items.en: He keeps doing his hard job with great patience.
items.hi: वह अपना कठिन काम बड़े धैर्य से करता जा रहा है।
items.gu: તે પોતાનું અઘરું કામ ખૂબ ધીરજથી કરતો રહે છે.

opts.en: wrong — たい should not be voiced

items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.5, PDF 89). Book's notes (paraphrased): 忍耐 = にんたい. 忍 = ニン (忍術, 残忍) and しの(ぶ) (endure, hide); 耐 = タイ (耐久, 耐水, 耐火) and た(える) (endure). 選択肢の言葉: 1 人体. (added, not in book) Trap type 2 (清音 / 濁音): after ん a sound often becomes voiced (e.g. 三階 さんがい), but 耐 stays たい in 忍耐 — compare 耐久 たいきゅう. じんたい sounds similar but is a completely different word.

items.q: 彼女が仕事をするときの手際のよさには驚かされる。
items.qr: Kanojo ga shigoto o suru toki no tegiwa no yosa ni wa odorokasareru.
items.en: I'm amazed at how deftly she handles her work.
items.hi: काम करते समय उसकी फुर्ती और कुशलता देखकर हैरानी होती है।
items.gu: કામ કરતી વખતે તેની ઝડપ અને કુશળતા જોઈને નવાઈ લાગે છે.

opts.en: hosting, sponsoring (主催) / presiding, running a group (主宰)

items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.5–6, PDF 89–90). Book's notes (paraphrased): 手際 = てぎわ (manner of doing, skill). 手 = シュ (手芸, 名手) and て (手順, 手配, 手本 …); 際 = サイ (際限 = limit) and きわ／ぎわ (窓際 = by the window). 選択肢の言葉: 3 主催 / 主宰. (added, not in book) 手際 is kun + kun, and 際 is voiced to ぎわ as the second element, exactly like 窓際 まどぎわ. Options 1 and 2 mix reading systems.

items.q: たとえ貧乏でも、愛があれば幸せだ。
items.qr: Tatoe binbou demo, ai ga areba shiawase da.
items.en: Even if you are poor, you can be happy if there is love.
items.hi: भले ही ग़रीबी हो, प्यार हो तो इंसान ख़ुश रहता है।
items.gu: ભલે ગરીબી હોય, પ્રેમ હોય તો માણસ સુખી છે.
items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.6, PDF 90). Book's notes (paraphrased): 貧乏 = びんぼう. 貧 has ヒン (貧血, 貧困, 貧弱), ビン (only 貧乏) and まず(しい); 乏 has ボウ (窮乏, 欠乏) and とぼ(しい). (added, not in book) Three traps at once: voiced び (not ひ), voiced ぼ (not ほ / ぽ), and a long vowel ぼう. びんぼ is how people sometimes say it casually, but the dictionary reading is びんぼう.

items.q: 今、夏休みの北海道旅行の計画を練っている。
items.qr: Ima, natsuyasumi no Hokkaidou ryokou no keikaku o nette iru.
items.en: I'm now working out the plan for my summer-holiday trip to Hokkaido.
items.hi: मैं अभी गर्मी की छुट्टियों में होक्काइदो यात्रा की योजना बारीकी से बना रहा/रही हूँ।
items.gu: હું અત્યારે ઉનાળાની રજાઓમાં હોક્કાઇડો પ્રવાસની યોજના વિગતવાર ઘડી રહ્યો/રહી છું.

opts.en: holding out, persisting; being sticky (粘る)

items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.6, PDF 90). Book's notes (paraphrased): 練る = ねる (polish, refine, work out a plan); on-yomi レン (試練, 洗練, 熟練). 選択肢の言葉: 1 沿っている (沿う), 2 粘っている (粘る), 3 担っている (担う). (added, not in book) ねばっている shares ね- with the answer and is about "sticking at it", so it looks plausible — but its kanji is 粘. 計画を練る / 対策を練る / 作戦を練る are the standard collocations.

items.q: 果てしない宇宙をいつか旅してみたい。
items.qr: Hateshinai uchuu o itsuka tabi shite mitai.
items.en: Some day I'd like to travel through boundless space.
items.hi: किसी दिन मैं अनंत अंतरिक्ष की यात्रा करना चाहता/चाहती हूँ।
items.gu: કોઈક દિવસ મારે અનંત અવકાશની યાત્રા કરવી છે.

opts.en: not the reading of 果てしない
not the reading of 果てしない

items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.6–7, PDF 90–91). Book's notes (paraphrased): 果てしない = はてしない = 終わりがない (having no end). 果 = カ (果実, 効果, 成果) and は(てる) / は(たす) / 果て (the end). (added, not in book) The 別冊 gives no kanji for the wrong options; かてしない is the trap because カ is 果's on-yomi, but in this word 果 is kun-yomi は (果て = end + しない).

items.q: 対立する意見を折衷して結論を出した。
items.qr: Tairitsu suru iken o secchuu shite ketsuron o dashita.
items.en: We reached a conclusion by blending the opposing opinions into a compromise.
items.hi: परस्पर विरोधी रायों के बीच का रास्ता निकालकर हमने निष्कर्ष निकाला।
items.gu: સામસામેના મતો વચ્ચે સમાધાન કરીને અમે નિષ્કર્ષ કાઢ્યો.

opts.en: wrong — the small っ is missing

items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.7, PDF 91). Book's notes (paraphrased): 折衷 = せっちゅう (mixing, compromise). 折 = セツ (折角 せっかく, 骨折, 右折, 挫折), お(れる)／お(る), おり (occasion); 衷 = チュウ (衷心). 選択肢の言葉: 1 折り合い. (added, not in book) Trap type 3: セツ + ch-sound → せっ (as in 折角 せっかく). 折り合い has a similar meaning ("compromise") — which makes it tempting — but it is written with okurigana and is not the reading of 折衷.

items.q: 職場で仕事中に人の噂話（うわさばなし）をするのは慎むべきだ。
items.qr: Shokuba de shigotochuu ni hito no uwasabanashi o suru no wa tsutsushimu beki da.
items.en: You should refrain from gossiping about people while working at the office.
items.hi: दफ़्तर में काम के दौरान दूसरों के बारे में गपशप करने से बचना चाहिए।
items.gu: ઑફિસમાં કામ દરમિયાન બીજાઓ વિશે કૂથલી કરવાથી દૂર રહેવું જોઈએ.
items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.7, PDF 91). Book's notes (paraphrased): 慎む = つつしむ (keep from doing, be careful not to); on-yomi シン as in 慎重 (careful) and 謹慎. 選択肢の言葉: 3 慈しむ, 4 はにかむ. (added, not in book) しんむ is the trap: シン is the on-yomi, but on-yomi never takes the verb ending む. 言動を慎む, 酒を慎む are common collocations.

items.q: 私は山の麓の静かな町で少年時代を過ごした。
items.qr: Watashi wa yama no fumoto no shizuka na machi de shounen jidai o sugoshita.
items.en: I spent my boyhood in a quiet town at the foot of a mountain.
items.hi: मैंने अपना बचपन पहाड़ की तलहटी के एक शांत कस्बे में बिताया।
items.gu: મેં મારું બાળપણ પર્વતની તળેટીના એક શાંત ગામમાં વિતાવ્યું.

opts.en: on-yomi of 麓 (only in compounds like 山麓)
opts.hi: (麓 का ऑन पठन, केवल 山麓 जैसे शब्दों में)
opts.gu: (麓નું ઓન વાંચન, ફક્ત 山麓 જેવા શબ્દોમાં)

opts.en: gentle lower slopes of a mountain (裾野)

items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.7, PDF 91). Book's notes (paraphrased): 麓 = ふもと; on-yomi ロク as in 山麓 (さんろく). 選択肢の言葉: 3 裾野, 4 鹿. (added, not in book) 麓 is built from 林 over 鹿 — that is why しか (鹿) is offered as a trap. すその is close in meaning, but it is written 裾野. On its own, 麓 is read with the kun-yomi ふもと.

items.q: 国際交流のイベントを催す計画が進んでいる。
items.qr: Kokusai kouryuu no ibento o moyoosu keikaku ga susunde iru.
items.en: Plans to hold an international exchange event are under way.
items.hi: अंतरराष्ट्रीय आदान-प्रदान का एक कार्यक्रम आयोजित करने की योजना आगे बढ़ रही है।
items.gu: આંતરરાષ્ટ્રીય આદાનપ્રદાનનો કાર્યક્રમ યોજવાની યોજના આગળ વધી રહી છે.
items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.7, PDF 91). Book's notes (paraphrased): 催す = もよおす (hold an event); on-yomi サイ as in 催促, 開催, 主催; 催し物 = an event. 選択肢の言葉: 1 施す, 4 促す. (added, not in book) うながす is the trap: 催促 (さいそく) means "pressing someone", and 促 = うながす — but 促 and 催 are different kanji. 催す also means "feel (an urge)": 眠気を催す.

items.q: この庭には花の香りが漂っている。
items.qr: Kono niwa ni wa hana no kaori ga tadayotte iru.
items.en: The scent of flowers hangs in the air in this garden.
items.hi: इस बगीचे में फूलों की ख़ुशबू फैली हुई है।
items.gu: આ બગીચામાં ફૂલોની સુગંધ ફેલાયેલી છે.

opts.en: be held up, fall behind (滞る)
drift, hang in the air (漂う)

items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.7, PDF 91). Book's notes (paraphrased): 漂う = ただよう (float, drift, hang in the air); on-yomi ヒョウ as in 漂流. 選択肢の言葉: 1 逆らって (逆らう), 2 操って (操る), 3 滞って (滞る). (added, not in book) 漂う and 滞る both have 氵 and were already paired in 第1回 Q2 — the book deliberately reuses them as each other's distractors.

items.q: この国の国民の大部分が貧困と闘っている。
items.qr: Kono kuni no kokumin no daibubun ga hinkon to tatakatte iru.
items.en: Most of this country's people are fighting poverty.
items.hi: इस देश के ज़्यादातर नागरिक ग़रीबी से जूझ रहे हैं।
items.gu: આ દેશના મોટા ભાગના નાગરિકો ગરીબી સામે લડી રહ્યા છે.

opts.en: not a word (困 is not いん)
wrong — び is only for 貧乏

items.why: Answer 4 — reasoned, official key page missing from the scan (別冊 pp.8–9 are not in the PDF; not from the official key). The answer is supported by the book itself: the 別冊 p.6 (PDF 90) kanji block for 貧 (in Q13) lists 貧困（ひんこん）. (added, not in book) 貧 = ヒン in compounds (貧困, 貧血) and ビン only in 貧乏, so 1 and 3 are traps carried over from Q13. 困 = コン (困難); いん would be the reading of 因 (原因), which looks

items.q: これは彼の作品の中で最高の傑作だ。
items.qr: Kore wa kare no sakuhin no naka de saikou no kessaku da.
items.en: This is the greatest masterpiece among his works.
items.hi: यह उसकी रचनाओं में सबसे बेहतरीन कृति है।
items.gu: આ તેની કૃતિઓમાં સૌથી ઉત્તમ કૃતિ છે.

opts.en: wrong — 作 must be さく here
wrong — けつ shortened without っ
wrong — the small っ is missing

items.why: Answer 3 — reasoned, official key page missing from the scan (別冊 pp.8–9 are not in the PDF; not from the official key). The answer is supported by the book itself: the 別冊 p.10 (PDF 92) kanji block for 作 (in Q27) lists 傑作（けっさく）. (added, not in book) 傑 = ケツ, 作 = サク. Trap type 3: ケツ + s-sound → けっ, so 傑作 = けっさく (like 傑出 けっしゅつ). 作 is サ only in some words (作業 さぎょう, 動作 どうさ), so けっさ (1) is wrong; 2 and 4

items.q: 彼女は細やかな心づかいのできる人だ。
items.qr: Kanojo wa komayaka na kokorozukai no dekiru hito da.
items.en: She is someone who can show thoughtful, attentive consideration for others.
items.hi: वह छोटी-छोटी बातों का ध्यान रखकर दूसरों की परवाह करने वाली इंसान है।
items.gu: તે નાની નાની વાતોનું ધ્યાન રાખીને બીજાની કાળજી લેનારી વ્યક્તિ છે.

opts.hi: बारीकी से ध्यान रखने वाला, स्नेहपूर्ण

opts.en: slender (rare word) — not the reading here
not a word (on-yomi サイ + やか)

items.why: Answer 1 — reasoned, official key page missing from the scan (別冊 pp.8–9 are not in the PDF; not from the official key). (added, not in book) 細 has two kun-yomi: こま(か／かい) "fine, detailed" and ほそ(い) "thin". 細やか is read こまやか and is used for feelings and care (細やかな心づかい / 愛情). ほそやか exists only as a rare word for "slender", and does not fit 心づかい. ひそやか is written 密やか; さいやか is not a word.

items.q: 製品の良し悪しは見た目ではよくわからない。
items.qr: Seihin no yoshiashi wa mitame de wa yoku wakaranai.
items.en: You can't really tell whether a product is good or bad from how it looks.
items.hi: किसी उत्पाद का अच्छा या बुरा होना उसकी शक्ल देखकर ठीक से पता नहीं चलता।
items.gu: કોઈ ઉત્પાદન સારું છે કે ખરાબ તે દેખાવ પરથી બરાબર ખબર પડતી નથી.
items.why: Answer 4 — reasoned, official key page missing from the scan (別冊 pp.8–9 are not in the PDF; not from the official key). (added, not in book) 良し悪し uses the old classical adjective forms 良し (よし, "good") and 悪し (あし, "bad"), both kun-yomi. The trap is わる from 悪い: in this fixed word 悪 is あし, not わるし. Options 2 and 3 use the on-yomi りょう of 良, which never takes the ending し. (よしあし can also mean "having b

items.q: 社会生活において重要なことは、円滑な人間関係を築くことだ。
items.qr: Shakai seikatsu ni oite juuyou na koto wa, enkatsu na ningen kankei o kizuku koto da.
items.en: What matters in social life is building smooth, harmonious relationships with people.
items.hi: सामाजिक जीवन में ज़रूरी बात है लोगों के साथ सहज, सुचारु रिश्ते बनाना।
items.gu: સામાજિક જીવનમાં મહત્ત્વની વાત લોકો સાથે સરળ, સુમેળભર્યા સંબંધો બાંધવાની છે.

opts.en: wrong — 滑 read as コツ

items.why: Answer 3 — reasoned, official key page missing from the scan (別冊 pp.8–9 are not in the PDF; not from the official key). (added, not in book) 円滑 is an on + on compound: 円 = エン, 滑 = カツ. The trap is コツ: 滑 has the rare on-yomi コツ only in 滑稽 (こっけい), and the right-hand part 骨 (コツ) suggests it. Options 1 and 2 use the kun-yomi まる(い) and すべ(る), which do not appear in this compound.

items.q: 田中選手が今季限りで競技を退くそうだ。
items.qr: Tanaka senshu ga konki kagiri de kyougi o shirizoku sou da.
items.en: I hear Tanaka is retiring from the sport at the end of this season.
items.hi: सुना है कि तानाका खिलाड़ी इस सीज़न के बाद खेल से संन्यास ले रहे हैं।
items.gu: સાંભળ્યું છે કે તાનાકા ખેલાડી આ સીઝન પછી રમતમાંથી નિવૃત્ત થવાના છે.
items.why: Answer 1 — reasoned, official key page missing from the scan (別冊 pp.8–9 are not in the PDF; not from the official key). (added, not in book) 退く = しりぞく (withdraw, retire from a post or field); on-yomi タイ as in 引退 (retirement) — 競技を退く means the same as 引退する. 退く can also be read のく ("step aside"), but that is not an option. たいく wrongly puts a verb ending on the on-yomi; 導く and 嘆く are real verbs with

items.q: 「そんなことはわけないさ」と彼は無造作に言った。
items.qr: "Sonna koto wa wake nai sa" to kare wa muzousa ni itta.
items.en: "That's nothing — easy," he said casually.
items.hi: "यह तो कुछ भी नहीं, आसान है," उसने बेपरवाही से कहा।
items.gu: "એ તો કંઈ નથી, સહેલું છે," તેણે બેફિકરાઈથી કહ્યું.

opts.en: wrong — 作 must be さ
wrong — 無 must be む

items.why: Answer 4 — reasoned, official key page missing from the scan (the 正解 line for Q27 was on 別冊 p.9, which is not in the PDF; not from the official key). Supported by the surviving 漢字 blocks (別冊 p.10, PDF 92): 無 has ム (無能, 無用, 無論) and ブ (無愛想, 無難, 無礼); 造 = ゾウ (偽造, 構造, 木造); 作 = サク (作戦, 傑作) and サ (作用, 発作). The book listing サ for 作 confirms むぞうさ. (added, not in book) Two traps: 無 = む here, not ぶ (ぶ is onl

items.q: 2つの町を隔てていた川に橋がかけられた。
items.qr: Futatsu no machi o hedatete ita kawa ni hashi ga kakerareta.
items.en: A bridge has been built across the river that separated the two towns.
items.hi: दो क़स्बों को अलग करने वाली नदी पर पुल बना दिया गया।
items.gu: બે નગરોને જુદાં પાડતી નદી પર પુલ બાંધવામાં આવ્યો.
items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.10, PDF 92). Book's notes (paraphrased): 隔てる = へだてる (divide, separate); 隔たる = be distant; 隔たり = gap. On-yomi カク as in 隔週, 隔離, 間隔. 選択肢の言葉: 3 そばだてて (そばだてる), 4 おだてて (おだてる). (added, not in book) All four options end in 〜だてて / 〜ばてて; only the kanji tells you. 耳をそばだてる (listen hard) and 人をおだてる (flatter) are usually written in kana.

items.q: 言論の自由が束縛される国もある。
items.qr: Genron no jiyuu ga sokubaku sareru kuni mo aru.
items.en: There are countries where freedom of speech is restricted.
items.hi: कुछ देशों में अभिव्यक्ति की आज़ादी पर बंदिशें लगाई जाती हैं।
items.gu: કેટલાક દેશોમાં વાણી-સ્વાતંત્ર્ય પર બંધનો મુકાય છે.
items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.10, PDF 92). Book's notes (paraphrased): 束縛 = そくばく. 束 = ソク (拘束, 結束), たば (bundle; 花束), たば(ねる), つか (束の間); 縛 = バク (呪縛) and しば(る) (tie, bind). (added, not in book) 1 and 3 use the kun-yomi たば; じゅう / せん come from kanji that look like 縛 (縦 じゅう, 繊 せん — both 糸-radical). 4 adds a 促音 that the word doesn't have.

items.q: 彼はいつも見栄を張って部下に食事をおごっている。
items.qr: Kare wa itsumo mie o hatte buka ni shokuji o ogotte iru.
items.en: To show off, he is always treating his subordinates to meals.
items.hi: दिखावे के लिए वह हमेशा अपने मातहतों को खाना खिलाता है।
items.gu: દેખાડો કરવા તે હંમેશાં પોતાના હાથ નીચેના લોકોને જમાડે છે.

opts.en: wrong — kun み + on エイ

items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.11, PDF 93). Book's notes (paraphrased): 見栄 = みえ (show, vanity, display). 見 = ケン (見識, 会見, 外見) and み(る／える／せる); 栄 = エイ (光栄, 虚栄, 繁栄) and さか(える). (added, not in book) This is trap type 6 (irregular reading): 栄 is just え here — the word comes from 見え ("how one looks") and the kanji was attached later. 虚栄 (きょえい, vanity) has a similar meaning but the normal reading.

items.q: テレビで紹介されて以来、店が繁盛するようになった。
items.qr: Terebi de shoukai sarete irai, mise ga hanjou suru you ni natta.
items.en: Ever since it was featured on TV, the shop has been doing very good business.
items.hi: टीवी पर दिखाए जाने के बाद से दुकान ख़ूब चलने लगी है।
items.gu: ટીવી પર બતાવ્યા પછી દુકાન ધમધોકાર ચાલવા લાગી છે.

opts.en: reflection (反省) / half a lifetime (半生)

items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.11, PDF 93). Book's notes (paraphrased): 繁盛 = はんじょう (prosperity, a thriving business). 繁 = ハン (繁栄, 繁華街, 頻繁) and しげ(る); 盛 = セイ (盛大, 全盛), ジョウ (繁盛), も(る), さか(る／り／ん). 選択肢の言葉: 2 反省 / 半生. (added, not in book) はんせい is the trap: セイ is 盛's usual on-yomi, but in 繁盛 it is ジョウ (trap type 5 — a kanji with many readings). Compare 繁栄 はんえい, which means the same thing.

items.q: 被災地では復興（ふっこう）に協力するボランティアを募っている。
items.qr: Hisaichi de wa fukkou ni kyouryoku suru borantia o tsunotte iru.
items.en: In the disaster area they are calling for volunteers to help with the reconstruction.
items.hi: आपदा-प्रभावित क्षेत्र में पुनर्निर्माण में मदद के लिए स्वयंसेवकों को बुलाया जा रहा है।
items.gu: આપત્તિગ્રસ્ત વિસ્તારમાં પુનર્નિર્માણમાં મદદ માટે સ્વયંસેવકોને બોલાવવામાં આવે છે.
items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.11, PDF 93). Book's notes (paraphrased): 募る = つのる (call for, advertise for, recruit); on-yomi ボ as in 募金, 応募. 選択肢の言葉: 2 慕って (慕う), 4 下って (下る). (added, not in book) 募 and 慕 share the top part 莫 — that's why したって is offered. Remember the bottom: 力 in 募 ("gather with effort") vs ⺗ (a form of 心) in 慕 ("feel for"). 募る also means "grow stronger" for feelings: 不安が募る.

items.q: この作品は情景の細かい描写が評価されている。
items.qr: Kono sakuhin wa joukei no komakai byousha ga hyouka sarete iru.
items.en: This work is praised for its detailed description of scenes.
items.hi: इस रचना की दृश्यों के बारीक चित्रण के लिए सराहना हो रही है।
items.gu: આ કૃતિની દૃશ્યોના ઝીણવટભર્યા વર્ણન માટે પ્રશંસા થાય છે.

opts.en: wrong — big よ instead of small ょ
opts.hi: (ग़लत — छोटे ょ की जगह बड़ा よ)
opts.gu: (ખોટું — નાના ょ ને બદલે મોટો よ)

items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.12, PDF 94). Book's notes (paraphrased): 描写 = びょうしゃ. 描 = ビョウ (素描) and えが(く) (draw, depict); 写 = シャ (写生, 映写, 試写会) and うつ(る／す). (added, not in book) 描 looks like 猫 (ねこ, ビョウ) — same sound. ひょう (1) drops the ゛ (trap type 2); びよう (2) tests whether you notice the small ょ (びょう = 1 syllable + long vowel, びよう = 3 syllables, like 美容).

items.q: 他人の成功を妬むのはやめよう。
items.qr: Tanin no seikou o netamu no wa yameyou.
items.en: Let's stop being jealous of other people's success.
items.hi: दूसरों की सफलता से जलना छोड़ दें।
items.gu: બીજાની સફળતાની અદેખાઈ કરવાનું છોડી દઈએ.

opts.en: feel resentful, have a chip on one's shoulder (僻む)
get tangled; pick a quarrel (絡む)

items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.12, PDF 94). Book's notes (paraphrased): 妬む = ねたむ (be jealous, envious); on-yomi ト as in 嫉妬 (しっと). 選択肢の言葉: 1 睨む, 2 僻む, 3 絡む. (added, not in book) ひがむ is close in feeling — but 僻む is feeling hard done by ("only I get treated badly"), while 妬む is resenting someone else's good fortune. Both 妬む and 僻む are often written in kana.

items.q: 待遇の改善を求めて、従業員がストライキを行った。
items.qr: Taiguu no kaizen o motomete, juugyouin ga sutoraiki o okonatta.
items.en: The employees went on strike demanding better working conditions.
items.hi: कर्मचारियों ने बेहतर सेवा-शर्तों की माँग करते हुए हड़ताल की।
items.gu: કર્મચારીઓએ સારી સેવા-શરતોની માગણી સાથે હડતાળ પાડી.

opts.en: wrong — 待 read like 寺 (ジ)
opts.hi: (ग़लत — 待 को 寺 (ジ) की तरह पढ़ा)

items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.12, PDF 94). Book's notes (paraphrased): 待遇 = たいぐう (treatment, working conditions). 待 = タイ (待望, 待機, 接待) and ま(つ) (待ち遠しい, 待ち合わせ); 遇 = グウ (遭遇, 優遇, 奇遇). (added, not in book) The 別冊 lists no wrong-option words here. 待 contains 寺 (ジ) and 遇 contains 禺 — options 2 and 4 play on these parts. 待遇 also means how you treat a guest: 手厚い待遇.

items.q: インターネットで電話料金の内訳を確認した。
items.qr: Intaanetto de denwa ryoukin no uchiwake o kakunin shita.
items.en: I checked the breakdown of my phone bill on the internet.
items.hi: मैंने इंटरनेट पर फ़ोन बिल का ब्योरा जाँचा।
items.gu: મેં ઇન્ટરનેટ પર ફોન બિલની વિગતો તપાસી.

opts.en: informal agreement (内約) — not the reading here

items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.12–13, PDF 94–95). Book's notes (paraphrased): 内訳 = うちわけ (breakdown of expenses). 内 = ナイ (内閣, 内緒, 内臓) and うち (内側); 訳 = ヤク (翻訳, 英訳) and わけ (reason). (added, not in book) A kun + kun word: うち + わけ ("dividing up the inside"). ないやく is the on + on reading, which looks natural but is not this word. Other kun + kun money words: 割引 わりびき, 手当 てあて.

items.q: 健康のために、酒はなるべく控えたほうがいい。
items.qr: Kenkou no tame ni, sake wa narubeku hikaeta hou ga ii.
items.en: For your health, you'd better cut down on alcohol as much as possible.
items.hi: सेहत के लिए शराब से जितना हो सके परहेज़ करना अच्छा है।
items.gu: તબિયત માટે દારૂથી બને તેટલું દૂર રહેવું સારું.

opts.en: put in order, line up (揃える)
hold down (押さえる) / restrain, suppress (抑える)
hold in one's arms; have (problems) (抱える)
cut down on, refrain from (控える)

items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.13, PDF 95). Book's notes (paraphrased): 控える = ひかえる (refrain from, cut down on); on-yomi コウ as in 控除. 選択肢の言葉: 1 揃えた (揃える), 2 押さえた (押さえる) / 抑えた (抑える), 3 抱えた (抱える). (added, not in book) おさえた is the tempting one because 抑える also means "keep (something) down" — 量を抑える. But the kanji in the sentence is 控, and 控える is the standard word for cutting down on alcohol, salt, going out (外出を控える).

items.q: 携帯電話の登場は、通信機器の新時代を開く画期的な出来事であった。
items.qr: Keitai denwa no toujou wa, tsuushin kiki no shinjidai o hiraku kakkiteki na dekigoto de atta.
items.en: The arrival of the mobile phone was an epoch-making event that opened a new era for communication devices.
items.hi: मोबाइल फ़ोन का आना संचार उपकरणों में नए युग की शुरुआत करने वाली युगांतरकारी घटना थी।
items.gu: મોબાઇલ ફોનનું આગમન સંચાર ઉપકરણોમાં નવા યુગની શરૂઆત કરનારી યુગપ્રવર્તક ઘટના હતી.

opts.en: wrong — 画 read as ガ
wrong — the small っ is missing

items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.13, PDF 95). Book's notes (paraphrased): 画期的 = かっきてき (epoch-making). 画 = ガ (画像, 動画) and カク (企画, 区画, 画数); 期 = キ (期日, 初期) and ゴ (最期); 的 = テキ (的確, 知的) and まと (target). (added, not in book) Two steps: 画 is カク here ("marking off" an era), and カク + k-sound → かっ (trap type 3, like 学期 がっき). ガ (1) is the "picture" reading; 4 forgets the 促音.

items.q: 彼は旅行の予定を変更して、その町に留まることにした。
items.qr: Kare wa ryokou no yotei o henkou shite, sono machi ni todomaru koto ni shita.
items.en: He changed his travel plans and decided to stay on in that town.
items.hi: उसने यात्रा का कार्यक्रम बदला और उसी शहर में रुकने का फ़ैसला किया।
items.gu: તેણે પ્રવાસનો કાર્યક્રમ બદલ્યો અને એ જ શહેરમાં રોકાવાનું નક્કી કર્યું.

opts.en: fit in (収まる) / calm down (治まる) / be paid, settle (納まる)
opts.hi: समा जाना / शांत होना / जमा होना
opts.gu: સમાઈ જવું / શાંત થવું / જમા થવું

items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.13–14, PDF 95–96). Book's notes (paraphrased): 留まる = とどまる (stay, remain). 留 = リュウ (留意, 残留, 保留), ル (留守), と(まる／める) (目に留まる = catch one's eye), とど(まる／める) (stay on; 例: went to Vietnam and stayed on there). 選択肢の言葉: 1 溜まる, 3 固まる, 4 収まる / 治まる / 納まる. (added, not in book) 留まる can also be read とまる — but とまる is not an option, and "stay in a town" is とどまる. 溜 (たまる) contains 留, which is why たまる is

items.q: 彼の言っていることは矛盾だらけだ。
items.qr: Kare no itte iru koto wa mujun darake da.
items.en: What he says is full of contradictions.
items.hi: उसकी बातें विरोधाभासों से भरी हैं।
items.gu: તેની વાતો વિરોધાભાસથી ભરેલી છે.

opts.en: wrong — 盾 is じゅん

items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.14, PDF 96). Book's notes (paraphrased): 矛盾 = むじゅん (inconsistency, contradiction). 矛 = ム (in 矛盾) and ほこ (spear); 盾 = ジュン (in 矛盾) and たて (shield). 選択肢の言葉: 1 従順 / 柔順. (added, not in book) The word comes from the Chinese story of a man selling a spear that pierces any shield and a shield no spear can pierce. 矛 looks like 柔 (ジュウ), which explains the じゅう- options.

items.q: 彼女はまだ若いのに、実際の年齢よりも老けて見える。
items.qr: Kanojo wa mada wakai noni, jissai no nenrei yori mo fukete mieru.
items.en: She is still young, yet she looks older than her real age.
items.hi: वह अभी जवान है, फिर भी अपनी असली उम्र से बड़ी दिखती है।
items.gu: તે હજી જુવાન છે, છતાં તેની સાચી ઉંમર કરતાં મોટી દેખાય છે.

opts.en: wrong — 老 is お only in 老いる
opts.hi: (ग़लत — お केवल 老いる में)

opts.en: wrong — on-yomi ロウ + けて

items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.14, PDF 96). Book's notes (paraphrased): 老ける = ふける (get old, look old). 老 = ロウ (老衰, 老朽化, 敬老), ふ(ける), お(いる). 選択肢の言葉: 4 呆けて (呆ける). (added, not in book) 老 has two kun-yomi verbs: 老ける ふける (look older) and 老いる おいる (grow old). The okurigana tells you which: 〜ける → ふける, 〜いる → おいる. おける mixes them.

items.q: 手紙の宛名を書き間違えるのはとても失礼だ。
items.qr: Tegami no atena o kakimachigaeru no wa totemo shitsurei da.
items.en: Writing the address on a letter wrongly is very rude.
items.hi: चिट्ठी पर पाने वाले का नाम-पता ग़लत लिखना बहुत अशिष्टता है।
items.gu: પત્ર પર મેળવનારનું નામ-સરનામું ખોટું લખવું એ ખૂબ અવિવેક છે.

opts.en: full name (氏名) / nomination (指名) / mission (使命)

items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.14, PDF 96). Book's notes (paraphrased): 宛名 = あてな (mailing address). 宛 = あて (宛先); 名 = メイ (名産, 名簿, 名誉), ミョウ (本名), な (あだ名, 名残). 選択肢の言葉: 1 延命, 2 氏名 / 指名 / 使命, 3 あだ名. (added, not in book) 宛 contains 夗 (like 苑 エン), which is why えんめい is offered; あだな is one kana away from あてな. Kun + kun: あて + な.

items.q: 事業の拡張にともなって、新しい従業員を雇うことにした。
items.qr: Jigyou no kakuchou ni tomonatte, atarashii juugyouin o yatou koto ni shita.
items.en: As the business expanded, we decided to hire new employees.
items.hi: कारोबार के विस्तार के साथ हमने नए कर्मचारी रखने का फ़ैसला किया।
items.gu: ધંધાના વિસ્તાર સાથે અમે નવા કર્મચારીઓ રાખવાનું નક્કી કર્યું.

opts.en: come true (叶う) / suit (適う) / match, rival (敵う)
opts.hi: पूरा होना / उचित होना / बराबरी करना
opts.gu: પૂરું થવું / યોગ્ય હોવું / બરાબરી કરવી

items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.14, PDF 96). Book's notes (paraphrased): 雇う = やとう (hire); on-yomi コ as in 雇用, 解雇. 選択肢の言葉: 2 賄う, 3 叶う / 適う / 敵う, 4 慕う. (added, not in book) All four are 〜う verbs of three kana. まかなう is tempting in a business sentence (人件費を賄う "cover staff costs"), but its kanji is 賄. 雇 has 戸 on top — think "bring someone in through the door".

items.q: 昨夜は友人とお洒落なレストランで食事をした。
items.qr: Sakuya wa yuujin to oshare na resutoran de shokuji o shita.
items.en: Last night I had dinner with a friend at a stylish restaurant.
items.hi: कल रात मैंने एक दोस्त के साथ एक स्टाइलिश रेस्तराँ में खाना खाया।
items.gu: ગઈ રાતે મેં એક મિત્ર સાથે એક સ્ટાઇલિશ રેસ્ટોરાંમાં જમ્યો/જમી.

opts.en: not a word (洒 read like 酒 さけ)
opts.hi: (कोई शब्द नहीं — 洒 को 酒 समझा)
opts.gu: (કોઈ શબ્દ નથી — 洒ને 酒 માન્યું)

opts.en: not a word (洒 read like 酒 シュ)

items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.15, PDF 97). Book's notes (paraphrased): 洒落 = しゃれ (stylishness, fashionableness). 洒 = シャ (in 洒落); 落 = ラク (落選, 落下, 集落) and お(ちる／とす). The 別冊 marks「しゃれ」as an exceptional reading. (added, not in book) 洒 differs from 酒 (さけ, シュ) by one stroke — options 1 and 3 are built on that confusion. This word is also on the p.3 list of special readings (trap type 6; see 第1回).

items.q: 早いもので、この制度が発足して10年になる。
items.qr: Hayai mono de, kono seido ga hossoku shite juunen ni naru.
items.en: Time flies — it's already ten years since this system was launched.
items.hi: समय कितनी जल्दी बीतता है — इस व्यवस्था को शुरू हुए दस साल हो गए।
items.gu: સમય કેટલો ઝડપથી જાય છે — આ વ્યવસ્થા શરૂ થયાને દસ વર્ષ થઈ ગયાં.

opts.en: not a word (wrong on-yomi, no っ)

items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.15, PDF 97). Book's notes (paraphrased): 発足 = ほっそく (start, set out). 発 = ハツ／パツ (発育, 開発, 反発) and ホツ (発起人 ほっきにん, 発作 ほっさ, 発端 ほったん); 足 = ソク (補足), あし, た(る／りる／す). 選択肢の言葉: 3 補足. (added, not in book) Two traps at once: 発 takes its rarer reading ホツ, and ホツ + s → ほっ (trap type 3). はっそく is also heard nowadays, but it is not an option; the standard reading is ほっそく. ほそく (補足) differs only by the

items.q: 手土産を携えて上司の家を訪問した。
items.qr: Temiyage o tazusaete joushi no ie o houmon shita.
items.en: I visited my boss's home, taking a small gift with me.
items.hi: मैं एक छोटा तोहफ़ा लेकर अपने बॉस के घर गया/गई।
items.gu: હું એક નાની ભેટ લઈને મારા બૉસના ઘરે ગયો/ગઈ.

opts.en: preparing for; offering (備える・供える)

items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.15, PDF 97). Book's notes (paraphrased): 携える = たずさえる (carry, take along); 携わる = たずさわる (be engaged in a field). On-yomi ケイ as in 携帯, 連携. 選択肢の言葉: 1 抱えて (抱える), 3 備えて (備える), 4 求めて (求める). (added, not in book) かかえて is the trap — you might "hold" a gift — but its kanji is 抱. 携帯 (keitai, mobile phone) literally means "something carried", which helps you remember 携 = carry.

items.q: 登山は体力を消耗する。
items.qr: Tozan wa tairyoku o shoumou suru.
items.en: Mountain climbing uses up a lot of stamina.
items.hi: पहाड़ चढ़ने में शरीर की बहुत ताक़त ख़र्च होती है।
items.gu: પર્વત ચઢવામાં શરીરની ઘણી શક્તિ વપરાઈ જાય છે.
items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.15–16, PDF 97–98). Book's notes (paraphrased): 消耗 = しょうもう (be worn out, consume). 消 = ショウ (消去, 消息, 解消), き(える), け(す); 耗 = モウ (消耗) and コウ (心神耗弱). 選択肢の言葉: 1 所望. (added, not in book) A pure long-vowel question (trap type 1): both halves are long — しょう + もう. しょもう is a real word (所望, "wish") but a different one. 消耗品 (しょうもうひん) = consumables.

items.q: ドアの隙間から風が入ってきて寒い。
items.qr: Doa no sukima kara kaze ga haitte kite samui.
items.en: Wind is coming in through the gap in the door, and it's cold.
items.hi: दरवाज़े की दरार से हवा अंदर आ रही है, ठंड लग रही है।
items.gu: બારણાની તિરાડમાંથી પવન અંદર આવે છે, ઠંડી લાગે છે.

opts.en: not a word (both on-yomi, wrong order of 間隙)

items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.16, PDF 98). Book's notes (paraphrased): 隙間 = すきま (space, crack, gap). 隙 = ゲキ (間隙 かんげき) and すき (an opening, a chance); 間 = カン (間隔, 民間), ケン (世間), あいだ, ま (間に合う, 間取り). (added, not in book) Kun + kun: すき + ま. The on-yomi compound with the same kanji is 間隙 かんげき (reverse order) — option 2 tries to trick you with it.

items.q: 我々の連勝を阻む強敵が現れた。
items.qr: Wareware no renshou o habamu kyouteki ga arawareta.
items.en: A strong rival has appeared who could block our winning streak.
items.hi: हमारी लगातार जीत को रोकने वाला एक मज़बूत प्रतिद्वंद्वी सामने आया है।
items.gu: અમારી સતત જીતને અટકાવે એવો એક મજબૂત હરીફ આવ્યો છે.
items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.16, PDF 98). Book's notes (paraphrased): 阻む = はばむ (block, prevent); on-yomi ソ as in 阻止, 阻害. 選択肢の言葉: 1 拒む, 3 危ぶむ, 4 慎む. (added, not in book) こばむ is the trap: same 〜ばむ ending and a related meaning ("refuse" vs "block"). 拒む = say no to something (要求を拒む); 阻む = physically or figuratively stop progress (行く手を阻む). 慎む was tested in 第3回 Q17.

items.q: 彼は面倒見（めんどうみ）がいいので、大勢の後輩に慕われている。
items.qr: Kare wa mendoumi ga ii node, oozei no kouhai ni shitawarete iru.
items.en: He takes good care of people, so many juniors look up to him.
items.hi: वह दूसरों का बहुत ख़याल रखता है, इसलिए कई जूनियर उसे बहुत मानते हैं।
items.gu: તે બીજાઓની ખૂબ કાળજી લે છે, તેથી ઘણા જુનિયર તેને ખૂબ માન આપે છે.
items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.16, PDF 98). Book's notes (paraphrased): 慕う = したう (like, adore, be attached to); on-yomi ボ as in 慕情, 思慕. 選択肢の言葉: 1 構われて (構う), 2 担われて (担う), 4 思われて (思う). (added, not in book) 慕う appeared as a distractor in 第6回 Q32 (募る) — now it's the answer. 慕 has 心 (⺗) at the bottom: a feeling. All four options are passive 〜われて forms, so only the kanji decides.

items.q: 彼女は炊事があまり好きではない。
items.qr: Kanojo wa suiji ga amari suki de wa nai.
items.en: She doesn't much like cooking.
items.hi: उसे खाना बनाना ज़्यादा पसंद नहीं।
items.gu: તેને રસોઈ કરવી બહુ ગમતી નથી.
items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.16–17, PDF 98–99). Book's notes (paraphrased): 炊事 = すいじ (cooking). 炊 = スイ (炊飯器, 自炊) and た(く) (cook rice); 事 = ジ (事業, 事前), ズ (好事家), こと (事柄). 選択肢の言葉: 1 託児, 3 火事 / 家事. (added, not in book) 炊 = 火 + 欠, so 火事 (かじ) is the visual trap, and 家事 (housework) is the meaning trap. たくじ plays on the kun-yomi た(く).

items.q: 両親の期待に背いてしまって、無念だ。
items.qr: Ryoushin no kitai ni somuite shimatte, munen da.
items.en: I regret that I let my parents' expectations down.
items.hi: अफ़सोस है कि मैं माता-पिता की उम्मीदों पर खरा नहीं उतरा/उतरी।
items.gu: અફસોસ છે કે હું માતા-પિતાની અપેક્ષાઓ પર ખરો/ખરી ન ઊતર્યો/ઊતરી.

opts.en: wrong — on-yomi ハイ + verb ending
not a word (背 read like 北 ホク)

items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.17, PDF 99). Book's notes (paraphrased): 背く = そむく (disobey, go against); 背ける = そむける (turn away: 目を背ける). 背 also = ハイ (背景, 背後) and せ／せい (背が高い). 選択肢の言葉: 2 急いて (急く), with the proverb 急いては事を仕損じる ("haste makes waste"). (added, not in book) せいて is tempting because せ is a real reading of 背 — but せ means "back / height", not a verb. 背 contains 北 (ホク), the source of option 3.

items.q: 政治家のスキャンダルが暴露された。
items.qr: Seijika no sukyandaru ga bakuro sareta.
items.en: The politician's scandal was exposed.
items.hi: नेता के घोटाले का भंडाफोड़ हो गया।
items.gu: નેતાના કૌભાંડનો પર્દાફાશ થયો.

opts.en: wrong — 暴 is バク here

items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.17, PDF 99). Book's notes (paraphrased): 暴露 = ばくろ (disclose, expose). 暴 = ボウ (暴動, 暴力, 暴落), バク (only in 暴露), あば(く) (expose), あば(れる) (run wild); 露 = ロ (露骨, 露出), ロウ (披露), つゆ (dew). (added, not in book) ぼうろ is the trap: ボウ is 暴's usual reading. Remember the pair: 暴く (あばく, expose) and 暴露 (ばくろ, exposure) share the "expose" meaning and the rarer readings.

items.q: この小説は主人公の心の闇を描いている。
items.qr: Kono shousetsu wa shujinkou no kokoro no yami o egaite iru.
items.en: This novel depicts the darkness in the main character's heart.
items.hi: यह उपन्यास मुख्य पात्र के मन के अँधेरे का चित्रण करता है।
items.gu: આ નવલકથા મુખ્ય પાત્રના મનના અંધકારનું ચિત્રણ કરે છે.
items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.17, PDF 99). Book's notes (paraphrased): 闇 = やみ (darkness); 暗闇 (くらやみ) = darkness — 例: sitting still in the dark during a power cut. 選択肢の言葉: 1 音, 2 門 / 問 / 紋, 4 問い. (added, not in book) 闇 = 門 + 音, and every distractor is a reading of one of those parts (おと = 音, もん = 門, とい = 問 with 門 around 口). Learn 闇 as one picture: "a sound behind a gate — you can't see".

items.q: 高齢化社会をむかえ、介護サービスを提供する事業が増えている。
items.qr: Koureika shakai o mukae, kaigo saabisu o teikyou suru jigyou ga fuete iru.
items.en: With the arrival of an ageing society, businesses offering care services are increasing.
items.hi: बुज़ुर्ग होते समाज के आने के साथ देखभाल सेवाएँ देने वाले व्यवसाय बढ़ रहे हैं।
items.gu: વૃદ્ધ થતા સમાજના આગમન સાથે સંભાળ સેવાઓ આપતા વ્યવસાયો વધી રહ્યા છે.

opts.en: feelings (感情) / bill (勘定) / ring-shaped (環状)
venue (会場) / at sea (海上) / opening (開場) / upstairs (階上)
opts.hi: आयोजन-स्थल / समुद्र पर / द्वार खुलना / ऊपरी मंज़िल
opts.gu: સ્થળ / દરિયા પર / દરવાજા ખૂલવા / ઉપલો માળ

items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.17–18, PDF 99–100). Book's notes (paraphrased): 介護 = かいご (looking after the daily life of elderly or sick people). 介 = カイ (介入, 介在, 介抱, 仲介); 護 = ゴ (護衛, 看護, 弁護, 保護) and まも(る). 選択肢の言葉: 1 看護, 3 感情 / 勘定 / 環状, 4 会場 / 海上 / 開場 / 階上. (added, not in book) かんご (看護) is the closest trap: 看護 = medical nursing (看護師 = nurse); 介護 = everyday care (介護士 = care worker). 護 is short ご — not ごう or じょう.

items.q: 講義の要旨をまとめたものを配りますので、よく読んでおくこと。
items.qr: Kougi no youshi o matometa mono o kubarimasu node, yoku yonde oku koto.
items.en: I'll hand out a summary of the lecture's main points — read it carefully.
items.hi: मैं व्याख्यान के मुख्य बिंदुओं का सार बाँटूँगा, उसे ध्यान से पढ़ लेना।
items.gu: હું વ્યાખ્યાનના મુખ્ય મુદ્દાઓનો સાર વહેંચીશ, તે ધ્યાનથી વાંચી લેજો.

opts.en: guidelines (要項・要綱) / sunlight (陽光) / going abroad (洋行)

items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.18, PDF 100). Book's notes (paraphrased): 要旨 = ようし (summary). 要 = ヨウ (要因, 要請, 概要) and い(る); 旨 = シ (趣旨, 主旨) and むね (the gist: …旨を伝える). 選択肢の言葉: 1 幼児 / 用事, 3 要件 / 用件, 4 要項 / 要綱 / 陽光 / 洋行. (added, not in book) Trap type 2: 旨 is unvoiced シ — ようじ is a different word. 要件 / 要項 also start with 要 and are about documents, which makes 3 and 4 tempting.

items.q: この薬は胃腸の調子を整えてくれる。
items.qr: Kono kusuri wa ichou no choushi o totonoete kureru.
items.en: This medicine puts your stomach and bowels in good order.
items.hi: यह दवा पेट और आँतों की हालत ठीक रखती है।
items.gu: આ દવા પેટ અને આંતરડાંની તબિયત ઠીક રાખે છે.
items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.18, PDF 100). Book's notes (paraphrased): 整える = ととのえる (put in good shape); 整う = ととのう (be ready). On-yomi セイ as in 整列, 整然, 調整. 選択肢の言葉: 1 そびえて (そびえる), 2 抱えて (抱える), 3 振り替えて (振り替える). (added, not in book) All four end in 〜えて. 調子を整える (get into good condition), 準備が整う (preparations are complete) and 身なりを整える (tidy one's appearance) are the key collocations. 調整 (ちょうせい) has the same meaning in

items.q: 大地震による被災者の数は10万人を超えた。
items.qr: Daijishin ni yoru hisaisha no kazu wa juuman-nin o koeta.
items.en: The number of people affected by the great earthquake has passed 100,000.
items.hi: बड़े भूकंप से प्रभावित लोगों की संख्या एक लाख से ज़्यादा हो गई।
items.gu: મોટા ભૂકંપથી અસરગ્રસ્ત લોકોની સંખ્યા એક લાખને વટાવી ગઈ.

opts.en: not a word (被 read like 皮 かわ)

items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.18–19, PDF 100–101). Book's notes (paraphrased): 被災者 = ひさいしゃ (disaster victims). 被 = ヒ (被災, 被告) and こうむ(る) (suffer); 災 = サイ (災害, 火災, 天災) and わざわ(い); 者 = シャ (科学者, 当事者) and もの (うっかり者, 怠け者). 選択肢の言葉: 1 被害者, 2 負債者. (added, not in book) ひがいしゃ is the strongest trap — real word, same 被, same meaning area. But the kanji here is 災 (サイ, disaster), not 害 (ガイ, harm). 被 contains 皮 (かわ) — the sour

items.q: 博士はノーベル賞の受賞によって世界的な名声を獲得した。
items.qr: Hakase wa Nooberu-shou no jushou ni yotte sekaiteki na meisei o kakutoku shita.
items.en: By winning the Nobel Prize, the doctor gained worldwide fame.
items.hi: नोबेल पुरस्कार जीतकर डॉक्टर साहब ने विश्वव्यापी ख्याति पाई।
items.gu: નોબેલ પુરસ્કાર જીતીને ડૉક્ટર સાહેબે વિશ્વવ્યાપી ખ્યાતિ મેળવી.

opts.en: mastering (修得・習得) / finding lost property (拾得)
wrong — no 促音 in 獲得

items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.19, PDF 101). Book's notes (paraphrased): 獲得 = かくとく (earn, obtain). 獲 = カク (捕獲) and え (獲物); 得 = トク (得点, 所得, 説得, 取得, 習得), え(る), う(る). 選択肢の言葉: 1 如く, 3 修得 / 拾得 / 習得. (added, not in book) Trap type 3 does not apply here: カク / ク shrinks to っ mainly before a k-sound (画期的 かっきてき, 学期 がっき); before t it normally stays く (獲得 かくとく, 確定 かくてい), so かっとく is wrong. しゅうとく words are real but mean "learn

items.q: 船は左に舵を取った。
items.qr: Fune wa hidari ni kaji o totta.
items.en: The ship steered to the left.
items.hi: जहाज़ ने पतवार बाईं ओर घुमाई।
items.gu: વહાણે સુકાન ડાબી બાજુ વાળ્યું.

opts.en: on-yomi of 舵 (only in compounds like 方向舵)
opts.hi: (舵 का ऑन पठन, केवल यौगिकों में)

opts.en: reading of 蛇 (snake), not 舵

items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.19, PDF 101). Book's notes (paraphrased): 舵 = かじ (steering of a boat); on-yomi ダ as in 方向舵 (rudder). 例: a teacher's job is to "steer" (舵を取る) students so they learn efficiently. 選択肢の言葉: 2 and 4 = 蛇. (added, not in book) 舵 = 舟 (boat) + 它, and 蛇 = 虫 + 它 — same right-hand part, which is where じゃ / へび come from. Alone, 舵 is kun-yomi かじ.

items.q: 審判の判定に選手が異議を唱えることはできない。
items.qr: Shinpan no hantei ni senshu ga igi o tonaeru koto wa dekinai.
items.en: Players cannot raise objections to the referee's decision.
items.hi: खिलाड़ी रेफ़री के फ़ैसले पर आपत्ति नहीं उठा सकते।
items.gu: ખેલાડીઓ રેફરીના નિર્ણય સામે વાંધો ઉઠાવી શકતા નથી.

opts.en: restrain (抑える) / hold down (押さえる)

items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.19, PDF 101). Book's notes (paraphrased): 唱える = となえる (object, advocate, chant); on-yomi ショウ as in 唱歌, 提唱, 合唱. 選択肢の言葉: 2 称える, 3 抑える / 押さえる, 4 栄える. (added, not in book) All four are 〜える verbs. Key collocations: 異議を唱える (raise an objection), 説を唱える (advocate a theory), 念仏を唱える (chant a prayer). 栄える was in 第5回 Q30's kanji block.

items.q: お金を賭けてゲームをしてはいけません。
items.qr: Okane o kakete geemu o shite wa ikemasen.
items.en: You must not play games betting money.
items.hi: पैसे दाँव पर लगाकर खेल नहीं खेलने चाहिए।
items.gu: પૈસા દાવ પર લગાવીને રમત ન રમવી જોઈએ.
items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.19–20, PDF 101–102). Book's notes (paraphrased): 賭ける = かける (gamble, bet); on-yomi ト as in 賭博; 賭け = a bet, 賭け事 = gambling. 選択肢の言葉: 1 儲けて (儲ける), 2 預けて (預ける), 4 避けて (避ける). (added, not in book) 賭 has 貝 (money), like 儲 and 預 have money meanings — that's why もうけて and あずけて are offered. かける has many kanji (掛ける, 駆ける, 欠ける, 賭ける); 命を賭ける = risk one's life.

items.q: どんなに素晴らしい薬でも万人に効くとは限らない。
items.qr: Donna ni subarashii kusuri demo bannin ni kiku to wa kagiranai.
items.en: However wonderful a medicine is, it doesn't necessarily work for everyone.
items.hi: दवा कितनी भी अच्छी हो, ज़रूरी नहीं कि वह सब पर असर करे।
items.gu: દવા ગમે તેટલી સારી હોય, જરૂરી નથી કે તે બધા પર અસર કરે.
items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.20, PDF 102). Book's notes (paraphrased): 万人 = ばんにん (everyone). 万 = マン (万病, 巨万) and バン (万能, 万国); 人 = ジン (人格, 新人), ニン (人気, 証人), ひと (人柄, 人質), plus exceptional readings (玄人, 素人, 仲人, 若人, 大人, 一人, 二人). (added, not in book) Trap type 5 on both kanji. 万 = バン when it means "all" (万能, 万国, 万全); マン for the number 10,000 (一万). まんにん also exists in some dictionaries, but it is not an option — ばんにん

items.q: S社からの申し出を承諾することが会議で決定された。
items.qr: Esu-sha kara no moushide o shoudaku suru koto ga kaigi de kettei sareta.
items.en: The meeting decided to accept the offer from Company S.
items.hi: बैठक में कंपनी S का प्रस्ताव स्वीकार करने का फ़ैसला हुआ।
items.gu: બેઠકમાં કંપની Sનો પ્રસ્તાવ સ્વીકારવાનું નક્કી થયું.

opts.en: not a word (諾 read like 若 ジャク)

items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.20, PDF 102). Book's notes (paraphrased): 承諾 = しょうだく (approval, acceptance). 承 = ショウ (承知, 承認, 了承) and うけたまわ(る) (humble: receive, hear); 諾 = ダク (快諾, 受諾, 唯々諾々). 選択肢の言葉: 1 承認 / 証人, 2 承知. (added, not in book) 承認 and 承知 have the same first kanji and similar meanings, so knowing 諾 = ダク is what decides it. 諾 = 言 + 若, which explains the trap じゃく (若 = ジャク).

items.q: 開発による自然環境の悪化は、今後さらに深刻な状況に陥るだろう。
items.qr: Kaihatsu ni yoru shizen kankyou no akka wa, kongo sara ni shinkoku na joukyou ni ochiiru darou.
items.en: The damage to the natural environment from development will probably fall into an even more serious state from now on.
items.hi: विकास के कारण प्राकृतिक पर्यावरण की बिगड़ती हालत आगे और भी गंभीर स्थिति में पहुँच जाएगी।
items.gu: વિકાસને કારણે કુદરતી પર્યાવરણની બગડતી હાલત આગળ વધુ ગંભીર સ્થિતિમાં પહોંચશે.
items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.20–21, PDF 102–103). Book's notes (paraphrased): 陥る = おちいる (fall into); 陥れる = おとしいれる (trap, frame someone). On-yomi カン as in 陥没, 欠陥. 選択肢の言葉: 1 落ちる, 3 劣る, 4 訪れる. (added, not in book) おちる is the trap: the meaning is related (落ちる = fall), but 陥る is used for falling into a state — 危機・混乱・困難に陥る. Count the kana: お・ち・い・る.

items.q: その建物は古いけれど、どことなく風情がある。
items.qr: Sono tatemono wa furui keredo, doko to naku fuzei ga aru.
items.en: That building is old, but somehow it has a certain charm.
items.hi: वह इमारत पुरानी है, फिर भी उसमें कहीं न कहीं एक अनोखी छटा है।
items.gu: તે ઇમારત જૂની છે, છતાં તેમાં ક્યાંક ને ક્યાંક એક અનોખી છટા છે.

opts.en: wrong — 風 must be short ふ

items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.21, PDF 103). Book's notes (paraphrased): 風情 = ふぜい (charm, elegance, good taste). 風 = フウ (風習, 風土, 洋風), フ (only 風情), かぜ, かざ (風上); 情 = ジョウ (情勢, 情熱, 同情), ゼイ (only 風情), なさ(け). 選択肢の言葉: 1 婦女 / 扶助. (added, not in book) A double special reading (trap types 1 + 6): 風 shortens to ふ and 情 becomes ぜい only in this word. ふうじょ uses the everyday readings and ふうぜい gets only one of the two changes. L

items.q: 母親の飲酒はお腹の赤ちゃんの健康に弊害を及ぼすという。
items.qr: Hahaoya no inshu wa onaka no akachan no kenkou ni heigai o oyobosu to iu.
items.en: It is said that a mother's drinking harms the health of the baby in her womb.
items.hi: कहा जाता है कि माँ का शराब पीना गर्भ में पल रहे बच्चे की सेहत को नुक़सान पहुँचाता है।
items.gu: કહેવાય છે કે માતાનું દારૂ પીવું ગર્ભમાંના બાળકના સ્વાસ્થ્યને નુકસાન પહોંચાડે છે.

opts.en: spirit, backbone (気概) / injury, harm (危害)

items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.21, PDF 103). Book's notes (paraphrased): 弊害 = へいがい (harm). 弊 = ヘイ as in 疲弊; 害 = ガイ as in 害悪, 害虫, 危害, 水害, 災害, 妨害. 選択肢の言葉: 1 被害, 2 気概 / 危害, 4 障害. (added, not in book) All four end in 〜がい, so only the first kanji decides. 弊 (ヘイ) looks a little like 幣 (ヘイ, as in 紙幣) — both are へい. Collocation: 弊害を及ぼす / 弊害が生じる; 被害 is the damage someone suffers (被害を受ける).

items.q: 妹は無茶なダイエットをして体を壊してしまった。
items.qr: Imouto wa mucha na daietto o shite karada o kowashite shimatta.
items.en: My younger sister went on a reckless diet and ruined her health.
items.hi: मेरी छोटी बहन ने बेतुकी डाइटिंग की और अपनी सेहत बिगाड़ ली।
items.gu: મારી નાની બહેને અતિશય ડાયટિંગ કરી અને પોતાની તબિયત બગાડી નાખી.

opts.en: not the reading of 無茶 (茶 サ is only for 茶道, 喫茶)
not a word (無 ブ is for 無礼, 無難)

items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.21–22, PDF 103–104). Book's notes (paraphrased): 無茶 = むちゃ (extreme, unreasonable). 無 = ム (無意味, 無口, 無茶苦茶 …), ブ (無愛想, 無難, 無礼), な(い); 茶 = チャ (茶の間, 茶の湯, 紅茶) and サ (茶道, 喫茶). (added, not in book) Trap type 5 on both kanji: the four options are simply every combination of ム/ブ × チャ/サ. Remember the longer form 無茶苦茶 (むちゃくちゃ) — the same むちゃ. 無茶をする = do something reckless.

items.q: 地震の揺れを感じたら、すぐに机の下に潜ることです。
items.qr: Jishin no yure o kanjitara, sugu ni tsukue no shita ni moguru koto desu.
items.en: If you feel an earthquake shaking, you should get under a desk straight away.
items.hi: भूकंप के झटके महसूस हों तो तुरंत मेज़ के नीचे घुस जाना चाहिए।
items.gu: ભૂકંપના આંચકા લાગે તો તરત ટેબલ નીચે ઘૂસી જવું જોઈએ.

opts.en: fit into; get hooked on (嵌る)

items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.22, PDF 104). Book's notes (paraphrased): 潜る = もぐる (dive, go under). 潜 = セン (潜水, 潜入), もぐ(る), ひそ(む) (hide, lie hidden). 選択肢の言葉: 1 勝る, 3 隠れる, 4 嵌る. (added, not in book) かくれる is the meaning trap — taking cover under a desk feels like "hiding", but 隠れる is written 隠. 潜 has two kun-yomi: もぐる (go under something / underwater) and ひそむ (lurk, be hidden). The okurigana is the same 〜む / 〜る end

items.q: 不幸を嘆いてばかりいないで、新たな目標に向かって進もう。
items.qr: Fukou o nageite bakari inai de, arata na mokuhyou ni mukatte susumou.
items.en: Instead of just lamenting your misfortune, let's move on towards a new goal.
items.hi: सिर्फ़ अपने दुर्भाग्य पर रोते रहने के बजाय, नए लक्ष्य की ओर बढ़ें।
items.gu: ફક્ત પોતાના દુર્ભાગ્ય પર રડ્યા કરવાને બદલે, નવા લક્ષ્ય તરફ આગળ વધીએ.
items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.22, PDF 104). Book's notes (paraphrased): 嘆く = なげく (lament, grieve). 嘆 = タン (嘆願, 感嘆, 悲嘆), なげ(く), なげ(かわしい) (deplorable). 選択肢の言葉: 1 呟いて (呟く), 3 欺いて (欺く), 4 導いて (導く). (added, not in book) All four are 〜く verbs in て-form (〜いて), so the ending gives nothing away. 嘆 has 口 (mouth) like 呟, which is why つぶやく is offered. 嘆かわしい is a common N1 adjective: "deplorable, lamentable".

items.q: 求職者に仕事を斡旋するコーナーには長い行列ができていた。
items.qr: Kyuushokusha ni shigoto o assen suru koonaa ni wa nagai gyouretsu ga dekite ita.
items.en: There was a long queue at the counter that finds jobs for job seekers.
items.hi: नौकरी ढूँढ़ने वालों को काम दिलाने वाले काउंटर पर लंबी क़तार लगी थी।
items.gu: નોકરી શોધનારાઓને કામ અપાવતા કાઉન્ટર પર લાંબી કતાર લાગી હતી.

opts.en: infection (感染) / watching a game (観戦) / trunk line (幹線) / warship (艦船) / sweat gland (汗腺)
opts.hi: संक्रमण / मैच देखना / मुख्य लाइन / युद्धपोत / पसीने की ग्रंथि
opts.gu: ચેપ / મૅચ જોવી / મુખ્ય લાઇન / યુદ્ધજહાજ / પરસેવાની ગ્રંથિ

opts.en: not a word (斡 read like 幹 カン)
not a word (旋 is セン)

items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.22–23, PDF 104–105). Book's notes (paraphrased): 斡旋 = あっせん (introduce, help find a job). 斡 = アツ (only in 斡旋); 旋 = セン (旋回, 旋律, 凱旋). 選択肢の言葉: 1 感染 / 観戦 / 幹線 / 艦船 / 汗腺. (added, not in book) 斡 looks like 幹 (カン, trunk) — that's the かんせん trap. アツ + セン → あっせん: the ツ becomes a small っ (促音, trap type 3). 旋 must keep its ん, so 2 and 4 fail. Common uses: 就職の斡旋, 斡旋業者 (agency).

items.q: 知り合ってからまだ日が浅いので、私は彼の人柄をよく知りません。
items.qr: Shiriatte kara mada hi ga asai node, watashi wa kare no hitogara o yoku shirimasen.
items.en: It hasn't been long since we met, so I don't know his character well.
items.hi: हमें मिले अभी ज़्यादा दिन नहीं हुए, इसलिए मैं उसके स्वभाव को अच्छी तरह नहीं जानता।
items.gu: અમને મળ્યાને હજી બહુ દિવસ નથી થયા, એટલે હું તેના સ્વભાવને સારી રીતે જાણતો નથી.
items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.23, PDF 105). Book's notes (paraphrased): 人柄 = ひとがら (personality, character). 人 = ジン / ニン / ひと + exceptional readings (玄人, 素人, 仲人 …); 柄 = ヘイ (横柄), え (handle), がら (pattern). 選択肢の言葉: 1 人格, 3 人相, 4 人並み / 人波. (added, not in book) 人格 じんかく is a real word with a very close meaning, which makes it the strongest trap — but the kanji is 格, not 柄. 柄 as the second part of a compound is usually

items.q: この数日、川の水が濁っている。
items.qr: Kono suujitsu, kawa no mizu ga nigotte iru.
items.en: For the past few days the river water has been muddy.
items.hi: पिछले कुछ दिनों से नदी का पानी मटमैला है।
items.gu: છેલ્લા થોડા દિવસથી નદીનું પાણી ડહોળું છે.

opts.en: be mixed (混ざる / 交ざる)

items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.23, PDF 105). Book's notes (paraphrased): 濁る = にごる (become muddy/cloudy). 濁 = ダク (濁音, 濁流, 混濁), にご(る／す); 言葉を濁す = answer vaguely. 選択肢の言葉: 2 匂って / 臭って, 3 混ざって / 交ざって, 4 滞って. (added, not in book) 濁 has 氵 (water), as do 混 and 滞 — that's why まざって and とどこおって are offered. におって is the sound trap (に・お vs に・ご). 濁音 (dakuon) is the grammar term for が・ざ・だ・ば sounds — the same kanji.

items.q: 長年の願いがついに成就した。
items.qr: Naganen no negai ga tsui ni jouju shita.
items.en: My long-held wish has finally come true.
items.hi: मेरी बरसों पुरानी इच्छा आख़िरकार पूरी हो गई।
items.gu: મારી વર્ષો જૂની ઇચ્છા આખરે પૂરી થઈ.

opts.en: not the reading of 成就 (成 セイ is the everyday on-yomi)

items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.23–24, PDF 105–106). Book's notes (paraphrased): 成就 = じょうじゅ (accomplishment). 成 = セイ (成果, 成熟, 達成), ジョウ (成仏), な(る／す); 就 = シュウ (就職, 就任), ジュ (only in 成就), つ(く／ける). 選択肢の言葉: 4 常習. (added, not in book) Both kanji switch to their rare on-yomi here (trap type 5), so the "normal" pair せいしゅう is wrong. Note ジュ is short (じゅ, not じゅう). Set phrases: 願いが成就する, 恋愛成就 (a wish for love to come true, on

items.q: この辺りは起伏の多い土地で坂が多い。
items.qr: Kono atari wa kifuku no ooi tochi de saka ga ooi.
items.en: This area is hilly land with lots of slopes.
items.hi: यह इलाक़ा ऊबड़-खाबड़ ज़मीन वाला है और यहाँ बहुत ढलानें हैं।
items.gu: આ વિસ્તાર ઊંચી-નીચી જમીનવાળો છે અને અહીં ઘણા ઢોળાવ છે.
items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.24, PDF 106). Book's notes (paraphrased): 起伏 = きふく (ups and downs). 起 = キ (起源, 起点, 隆起, 提起), お(きる／こる／こす); 伏 = フク (伏線, 伏兵, 降伏), ふ(せる／す). 選択肢の言葉: 1 危険 / 棄権, 3 稀代. (added, not in book) 起 (rise) + 伏 (lie down) = "rising and falling". It is also used for feelings: 感情の起伏が激しい (moody, emotional ups and downs). きふせ mixes on-yomi キ with the kun-yomi ふせ(る).

items.q: 戦時中に武器を売って儲ける人がいる。
items.qr: Senjichuu ni buki o utte moukeru hito ga iru.
items.en: There are people who make money selling weapons in wartime.
items.hi: कुछ लोग युद्ध के समय हथियार बेचकर मुनाफ़ा कमाते हैं।
items.gu: કેટલાક લોકો યુદ્ધ દરમિયાન હથિયાર વેચીને નફો કમાય છે.

opts.en: not a word (儲 read like 諸 ショ)
bet (賭ける) / hang (掛ける) / lack (欠ける) / run (駆ける) / build across (架ける)
opts.hi: दाँव लगाना / टाँगना / कम होना / दौड़ना / (पुल) बनाना
opts.gu: દાવ લગાવવો / લટકાવવું / ખૂટવું / દોડવું / (પુલ) બાંધવો

opts.en: be convincing, understandable (頷ける, from 頷く "nod")

items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.24, PDF 106). Book's notes (paraphrased): 儲ける = もうける (make a profit, get rich). 儲 = もう(かる／ける): 儲かる = be profitable. 選択肢の言葉: 3 賭ける / 掛ける / 欠ける / 駆ける / 架ける, 4 頷ける (頷く). (added, not in book) 儲 = 亻 + 諸, which explains the trap しょ. かける links back to 第11回 Q62, where 賭けて was tested with もうけて as a distractor — the two words swap roles here. 儲かる (intransitive) vs 儲ける (transitive): 店が儲かる / 店で

items.q: 板をしばらく外に出しておいたら、太陽を浴びて反ってしまった。

items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.26, PDF 108). Book's notes (paraphrased): 欠陥 = けっかん (fault, deficiency). 欠 = ケツ (欠如, 欠乏, 欠勤, 出欠, 病欠), か(ける／く); 陥 = カン (陥没, 陥落), おちい(る), おとしい(れる). 選択肢の言葉: 2 血球. items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.26, PDF 108). Book's notes (paraphrased): 拭く = ふく (wipe, clean). 拭 = ショク (払拭), ふ(く). 選択肢の言葉: 1 掃いて / 履いて / 吐いて, 3 磨いて, 4 向いて / 剥いて. (added, not in book) はいて (掃く, sweep) and みがいて (polish) are both cleaning verbs, which is the trap. 拭く = wipe with a cloth; 掃く = sweep with a broom; 磨く = polish/scrub. 拭 = 扌 + 式 — don't confuse it with 式 (シキ). 払拭 (ふっしょく) = dispel (不安を払拭する).

items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.28, PDF 110). Book's notes (paraphrased): 摩擦 = まさつ (friction, conflict). 摩 = マ; 擦 = サツ (擦過傷), す(れる／る) (strike a match), こす(る) (rub). 選択肢の言葉: 4 抹殺.
